name: Trello
whatYouLose: Real-time updates when teammates move cards
Attachments, checklists and due-date reminders all wired to email
prompt:
Build a kanban board app, a Trello replacement for a small team.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, vanilla JS with native drag and drop, Server-Sent Events for live updates.
Features:
- Boards → lists → cards; drag cards between lists and reorder lists.
- Card details: description (markdown), labels, due date, checklist, comments.
- Live updates via SSE so two browsers see moves instantly.
- Magic-link email login, board members, archive/restore.
- Daily email digest of cards due tomorrow.
Done when: two browser windows on the same board stay in sync while dragging cards.
notes: The board itself is easy. Live sync, notifications and mobile apps are where the subscription earns its keep.
